# CrackersMela — Premium Fireworks Store

CrackersMela is a licensed fireworks dealer based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We sell PESO-certified crackers factory-direct from Sivakasi manufacturers to customers across Hyderabad and Secunderabad.

## Key Facts

- **115+ products** across **11 categories**
- **PESO-certified**, safety-tested stock from licensed Sivakasi manufacturers
- **Free delivery** on orders above ₹999
- **Cash on delivery** available
- **Same-day and next-day dispatch** across Hyderabad & Secunderabad
- **Customer support**: 9am – 9pm, every day

- Products range from ₹25 (basic sparklers) to ₹4,200 (premium garlands)
